text: Fiending Dark is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Darkness of the Conclave and Mind Quickening traits.
Ferryn was a night elf druid. His favorite shape was that of a nightsaber.
Fina Stillgrove is a night elf stable master located at the Cenarion Wildlands in Desolace.
Filmore Patricks is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Filigosa was a blue dragon who died from an unknown disease. Her name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Fingall Flamehammer is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, he appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Fire is a Pandaren spirit warrior created by the Brewmaster.
Fiona Stormwell is a human paladin of the Silver Hand located in Stratholme. She can be chosen to accompany the Highlord throughout the scenario during Stirring in the Shadows.
Firecaller Radison is a rare human found wandering the center isle in the Master's Glaive in Darkshore. He is on a 4-6 hour respawn timer.

First Mate Moody is a human located on the Llane's Oath in Deepholm. He is the first mate of the gunship and the sole survivor. He had slept through supper, where the Twilight cultists that had infiltrated the ship poisoned the food, and woke up with the rest of the crew already dead. He then ended up with a gut wound that he's currently dying from, as 'his insides are not where they should be'. Choosing to take action, he grabbed the wheel and is piloting the ship to keep it from crashing. When Stormcaller Mylra of the Earthen Ring and her adventurer assistant finds him, he tells them that he is dying and requires a Spool of Rope and a Bottle of Whiskey. Bringing him the two items, he has t
Firestarter Grash is an orc located at the Everbloom Wilds in Gorgrond.

First Mate Nereus is a jungle troll member of the "Bloodsail Boomers" who appears at the Bloodsail Buccaneers' beach party on the Cape of Stranglethorn's Wild Shore during Pirates' Day. He will occasionally burst into song alongside the other Bloodsail Boomers - Cook Lastwind, Gunner Pops, and Quartermaster Rowley.
First Mate Perry is a member of the Ashvane Trading Company located in the southwestern part of the Ashvane Encampment in Vol'dun, reading a map.
Firecaller is an orc located in Blackrock Foundry. He participates in the Blast Furnace encounter.
First Mate Cinderfuse is a dwarf located at Anyport in Drustvar.
First Mate Trixie Tornsail is a human located in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.

First Mate Ovdah is a rare elite Mag'har orc found in the Hoard of Shimmermaw of Hornswog Grounds in northeastern Forbidden Reach. Alongside Mad-Eye Carrey and Navigator Bi-Yun, they collectively serve as the Mad-Eye Carrey vignette.
First Mate Fitzgerald is a human is the first mate of The Kraken, which transports Alliance adventurers between the Stormwind Harbor and the port of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra.
Flakk is an orc trade supplies vendor located in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was present during the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar.

First Sergeant Hola'mahi is an orc PvP armor rewards vendor located in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar. She sells level 60 PvP set armor, Season 4 (Brutal Gladiator) and Guardian armor, Season 8 (Wrathful Gladiator) armor. After Vol'jin's death, she was seen speaking with Brave Stonehide and Stone Guard Zarg.

Fjorlin Frostbrow is a frost dwarf found at Frosthold in the Storm Peaks. An apparently tame Stormcrest Eagle hovers nearby. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard came to Frosthold. When Muradin Bronzebeard explained to the Frostborn that he couldn't stay for good, Fjorlin was quick to say that it is good to have two houses, as there is always a hearth to sleep at.

Fizz Lighter is a goblin mage trainer first encountered at the KTC Headquarters in Kezan. He can later be found at multiple locations within the Lost Isles and finally at his final home at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
Fish Fellreed is a pandaren farmer and a member of the Tillers.
Fix'dem A'rms was an orc found in Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Fizzsprings Caravan Driver is a human located in Stormsong Valley.
Firstmate Kaleson is a human located at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores.

Flamebringer is an elite proto-dragon located in Voldrune in Grizzly Hills. He is used in the quests The Thane of Voldrune (Alliance) and The Thane of Voldrune (Horde) against his master, Thane Torvald Eriksson.

Flarna Flametongue is a Dark Iron dwarf mage trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge. She is one of the Dark Iron dwarves that stayed with Moira Thaurissan after her reunion with the dwarves of Ironforge. She is standing with Pyromancer Scorchbrew and Lainda Gemgold, talking with them.

Flameweaver Koegler is a human located in the Scarlet Halls wing of the Scarlet Monastery. He serves as the third and last boss of the dungeon. Koegler was responsible for the destruction of many priceless artifacts, including almost all of the papers and books that told the real story about the Scarlet Crusade. He was killed by adventurers. Those who survived the encounter with him said that he was ashamed of what the Crusade had done.
Flaming Shots is a level 100 hunter talent, added in Warlords of Draenor.
Flare Up was a Fire mage honor talent, available at rank 43.
Flaming Soul is a Vengeance demon hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Erupting Souls and Concordance of the Legionfall traits.
Flamegullet is a proto-dragon located in the Ruby Life Pools.
Flamecaller Aymi is a dwarf located in the Intake Reservoirs in Halls of Infusion.

Fleet Master Firallon was a leader of the Bloodsail Buccaneers found around Booty Bay until he was killed. He is located on the Crimson Veil in the southernmost part of the Cape of Stranglethorn. When his health drops while in combat, he will try to flee. He has a pet parrot, Squawky Jr..

Fleet Admiral Tethys is a human located at the Hall of Shadows in Dalaran. He is a high-ranking member of the Bloodsail Buccaneers, a Shadow of the Uncrowned, and the leader of the infamous Bloodsail Buccaneers based around Booty Bay. Known to be a scurvy pirate and one of the greatest swashbucklers of the Great Sea, Tethys initially is accompanied by an axebeak named Crackers, but Crackers leaves him for the Shadowblade. He is then accompanied by a small hozen named Nanners, claiming that he can't be a successful pirate captain without a proper matey and that Nanners is more handy.
Fleet Navigator Norrison is a human located at the Proudmoore Academy in Boralus.

Flora Silverwind is a human herbalism trainer located in her shop, All Things Flora, in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. She is on the highest floor, in the southern section. She was previously with a male sailor, who eventually disappeared at sea. Upon being brought confirmation of his fate, she mentioned being interested in pursuing Kirsty Logan.

Flint Broadshot was a human hunter. One day he entered the Blue Recluse in Stormwind, seeking to buy ale for him and his friend. As payment he brought forth the body of a dead feline, telling the story of how he had managed to shoot it midair. A dwarf in the corner of the inn then rose, claiming that Flint was no honorable hunter, and that he hadn't shot it midair, but rather shot it while it had been in a snare. The dwarf then showed his face, he was none other than the world's greatest hunter Hemet Nesingwary, and he began telling a story of how he became such an honorable hunter.
Flurga is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Focusing Shot is a level 100 hunter talent. It replaces Steady Shot and Cobra Shot. It will trigger Steady Focus.
Focused Thunder is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Upwelling.
Fontane was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Fordred Aran was an archmage who Arthas killed when he raided Dalaran. His ghost was later put to rest by Kael'thas and Vashj when they escaped from the Dungeons of Dalaran.
Foreman Bonds was a level 30 human foreman found within the Azurelode Mine in the Hillsbrad Foothills. High Executor Darthalia wanted Bonds killed in order to disrupt supplies coming from the mine.
Foreman Miles McMoody is a dwarf found in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.

Footman Rob is a human footman of the Valiance Expedition found at the Valiant Rest inn of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. Along with his fellow soldiers George, Chuck and Mitch, Rob asks for one last beer before departing for the front.
Fordragon Carpenter is a human working on the fortifications for the Alliance portion of the offensive on the Wrathgate.
Footman Hordum is a dwarf found in Zul'Drak. He's protecting Alchemist Finklestein.
Footpad's Shirt is the starting shirt for human, dwarf, night elf, and gnome rogues.
Foreman Balsoth is a human of the Twilight's Hammer cult found at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore.
Footman James is a human found in a tavern on the road to Stratholme. He is having a conversation with Hearthsinger Forresten and Fras Siabi.
Footman Maxwell is a human found sitting in a tavern on the Road to Stratholme during the Culling of Stratholme.
Foreman Milos is a human trade goods vendor located in Andorhal. After the Alliance retreated, he didn't escape with them. His corpse lies on the path by the inn.
Foreman Tionn is a human located on Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle.
Foreman Wellson is a human ghost who was the foreman of the Wellson Shipyard in Tol Barad Peninsula. In life he was a great man. Sergeant Gray & Private Sarlosk want him killed.

Footman Mitch is a human footman of the Valiance Expedition at the Valiant Rest inn of Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. Along with his fellow soldiers Rob, George and Chuck, Mitch asks for one last beer before departing for the front.
Force-Commander Steeljaw is an orc ghost located at the Steeljaw's Caravan in the Borean Tundra. He appears when you take the Warsong Banner which is found next to his body.
Footpad's Vest is the starting chest for human, dwarf, night elf, and gnome rogues.
Foreman Bruntza is an orc located at the Iron Docks in Gorgrond.
Forbidden Flame is a Discipline priest artifact trait. It requires all other base traits to be purchased.
Force Barrier is an Arcane mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Aegwynn's Imperative, Rule of Threes (artifact trait) and Ethereal Sensitivity traits.
Force-Commander Xillious is a fel lord located in Broken Shore.
Foreman Tully is a human located in the Galson's Lode in the Arathi Highlands. She is also present during the Battle for Stromgarde, appearing in both versions.

Foreman Scripps is a human located at Highland Pass in Stormsong Valley. He is initially passive and overseeing the blockade until the Stormsong loyalist are shooed away during Border Issues. After that, he can be found as a rare mob near Scripps Lumber Co., which he is presumably head of.
Foreman Drogg is an orc located in Drywhisker Mine in the Arathi Highlands. He is also present during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Forgemaster Damrath is an iron dwarf located at the Thor Modan in Grizzly Hills. He is trying to hold the earthen from attacking the capital.
Forge Matron Targa is an orc found north of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Forgemistress Flamehand is an orc located at the Crucible in Blackrock Foundry.
Forinn Stoneheart is a dwarf located in the Crumbling Depths in Deepholm.
Forgemaster Farthing is a human located at the Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound.
Forgus Anvilrage is a Dark Iron dwarf located on the expedition isles.
Former Navigator Dublin is a human located in the Rotting Mire.
Forge-Guard Hurrul is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Dwarven District in the Vision of Stormwind.
Fortune Turned is a Mistweaver monk honor talent, available at rank 10.
Fortification is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Staggering Around trait.
Fort Wrynn Laborer is a human located in the hand of Ripgut just outside Fort Wrynn in Talador. When saved, he will run back to the fort.
Frast Dokner is a dwarf weapon vendor located in Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Frederic Burrhus is a human skinning trainer located in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.
Franklin Brinklestein is a Forsaken general goods vendor located at the Calston Estate in Tirisfal Glades.
Frank Natale is a human engineer and mining vendor located in the Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.
Francis Morcott is a worgen hunter and cook from Gilneas at Goodgrub Smoking Pit, who prefers the taste of bears, compared to , who prefers panther meat and , who prefers owl meat.

Captain Frandis Farley is a Forsaken warrior, who in life lived in the human kingdom of Stormwind. It has been observed that when not speaking, Frandis's jaw drops into a permanent gaping expression. He was sent by to command the undead troops in 's attack on Theramore Isle. He was a member of the Farley family which has run the Lion's Pride Inn for years, since the time of King Llane Wrynn I, and the brother of Innkeeper Farley.
Frederick Zyda is a human located at the sea base of Highbank in the Twilight Highlands.

Fredo was an SI:7 agent assigned to spy on the Nathanos Blightcaller. During the course of this mission, he was discovered and ultimately killed. His skeleton is found at Marris Stead, along with his SI:7 Insignia.
Fracture is a Vengeance demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Shear Fury.
Franzok is one of the two orc brawlers in Blackrock Foundry.

Franklin The Drunk is a human located on the lower dock at the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He was once an apprentice under Myra Cabot, who described him as "a damn fine miner," but he's since become a drunkard. His favorite drink is Brennadam Apple Brandy. His Horde counterpart is Biru The Drunk.
Frank Kowalkowski is a team member of the World of Warcraft team.
Friar Burlingham is a member of the Argent Crusade. He came to Outfitter Mendelev to stock up swimwear for his trip to Hardwrench Hideaway.
Frenk is a Dragonmaw orc general goods vendor found at the Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.
Freezing Rain is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Obsidian Lance and Glacial Eruption traits.
Friendly Pete is a human located at Castaway Point in Tiragarde Sound.
Friar Farshire is a human located in Valorcall Pass in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. He comes from Newstead and is riding a mule.
Frost King Malakk was the leader of the ice trolls of Gundrak and the ruler of the Drakkari Empire and tribe.
Frigid Dreadplate is a death knight talent located on tier 5 of the Frost tree.
Frost Aura was a death knight talent located on tier 7 of the Frost tree.
Frost Rune Mastery was a death knight talent located on tier 6 of the Frost tree.
Frost Fever is a Frost death knight disease caused by Icy Touch and Howling Blast.

Frits Fizzlesprocket is a character in the story A Very Smokywood Winter Veil told by Wulmort Jinglepocket during the Smokywood Storytime. Professor Frits has gone missing, and his daughter's only wish is for him to come back. It turns out that Fritz has been abducted by Dark Iron dwarves, seeking to use him to create a gigantic robot dressed as Greatfather Winter who would stole treasures from Ironforge. Before their plan is set in motion, Fritz was rescued by his daughter, Fala, and the goblin Krizz on top Metzen the Reindeer. He then retold his story and soon later invited Krizz for the Winter Veil Eve dinner.
Frogan is a frostwolf orc located at the Rangari Refuge in Tanaan Jungle. He has been appointed by to watch over the Laughing Skull refugees.
Frost is a dwarf located at the Bizmo's Brawlpub. He is Oso's master.
Frigid Executioner is a Frost death knight talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Rage of the Frozen Champion.

Frostwolf Quartermaster is an orc poison and reagent vendor found at Frostwolf Village in Alterac Valley. He appears during the Heritage of Draenor questline at Frostwolf Village, but doesn't sell anything.
Frostwolf Herald is an orc found inside Alterac Valley. He gives info about the strategy of Alterac Valley to Horde players.
Frostjaw is a mage talent available at level 45. It is a combined root-and-silence debuff.
Frostscreamer Raeger is a pale orc located in Frostfire Ridge.
Frostwolf Field Medic is an orc that participated in Battle of Thunder Pass in Frostfire Ridge.
Frostwall Scout is an orc located in Frostwall. He informs Sergeant Grimjaw about upcoming invasions.
Frostwolf Cold-Singer is an orc located in the Forbidden Cave in Frostfire Ridge. The orc is holding a Frozen Frostwolf Axe. Others appear at Grom'gar.
Frostwolf Leader is a Mag'har orc located in the Nagrand Arena.
Frozen Center is a Frost death knight honor talent, available at rank 10.
Frozen Veins is a Frost mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Jouster, Shield of Alodi, Icy Caress and Clarity of Thought traits.
Full Keg is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Exploding Keg (artifact trait), Gifted Student and Potent Kick traits.
Fu Lin is a pandaren monk of the Order of the Broken Temple located on the Wandering Isle.
Frozen Skin is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Frozen Core (death knight artifact trait), Cold as Ice, and Dead of Winter (artifact trait) traits.
Fujieda was a great warrior. According to jinyu tales, Fujieda slew a mighty demon after lying in wait in a shallow pool for hours.

Furious Attacks is a warrior talent in the Fury tree, you will need to spend 21 points in Fury to max it. It gives your normal melee attacks a chance to put a debuff on the target which reduces healing done to the target by 25%.

Furien's Post is a small blood elf forward post charged with monitoring potential adversaries to the Horde in Desolace. They were requested by the Cenarion Circle to keep an eye on one of their researchers, Korrah. It's a task the blood elves don't care for, but they occasionally check on Korrah so as to not get on the Cenarion Circle's bad side.
Furious Strikes is a level 45 warrior talent. It is available to Fury warriors.
Furious Swipes is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Jaws of Thunder and Unleash the Beast traits.
Furious Gaze is an Azerite trait available to Havoc demon hunters.
Fylerian Nightwing is a night elf druid trainer located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
Gabrielle Chase is a human cheese and drink vendor located at Morgan's Vigil in the Burning Steppes.
Gahurg is a human mage who corrupted Kirygosa's whelps into chromatic whelps under the orders of the Twilight Father.

Marshal Gabriel is a human officer in the Stormwind Army and Alliance military. He was first seen taking part in the battle for Ashran during the campaign in , where he was stationed in the Alliance headquarters at Stormshield Stronghold as a Conquest gear vendor. Since then, he has been transferred to the navy, given the new rank of Sky Marshall, and stationed onboard the Skyguard gunship. He was present when this vessel fought Horde forces on the Seething Shore for control of :Azerite deposits. He can now be found at the Salt and Shanty in Boralus with the title of Marshal again, before moving to Nazjatar where he is found in the Mezzamere. He has, so far, accompanied Grand Marshal Trembla
Fuzzywick is a worgen character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.
Gahla Grimfang is an orc located at Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
Gadar is a Mag'har orc located at the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar during Brewfest. He arrives to tap the keg twice a day.
Gan'rul Bloodeye was an orc located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, Gan'rul is found dead hanging from a rope in the tunnel leading into the Cleft of Shadow.
Gamili Frosthide is a dwarf cloth and leather armor vendor located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Galgann Firehammer is an elite Dark Iron dwarf mini-boss found in Dig Three in Uldaman.
Galgrom is an orc general goods, cheese and drink vendor located in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

Gamlen is a dwarf located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. When players ring the Farshire Town Hall Bell on the quest Call to Arms! (quest), he runs out of the town hall and yells to the militia to take up arms.
Galley Chief Dolinger is a human aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown.

Gakca was a human serving Katrana Prestor. He was ordered to kill the masked man that witnessed Lo'Gosh and then deliver a message to the Stormwind Assassins' Guild. His status after the revelation of Onyxia is unknown.
Galda Bronzeblade is a dwarf rogue trainer located in the town of Thelsamar in Loch Modan. She can be found inside the inn, speaking to Gindle the Green.
Gana Surehide is an orc located in Frostfire Ridge. She is staked to the ground in front of three sleeping Trained Coldsnout.
Galadran Gath is a human paladin located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Gamlor was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.

Galford was a human paladin of the Tyr's Guard and the brother of Travard, the leader of the order. In order to pass the wards protecting The Silver Hand (artifact), Galford journeyed to Northrend to seek aid from Tyr's homeland. When he arrived in Dragonblight, he met a blue dragon named Lanigosa at Wyrmrest Temple and asked her to hear stories about the Keeper Tyr. After he learned about the battle between Galakrond and Tyr, and how Kalecgos saw Tyr's severed hand at Galakrond's Rest, he got very excited and left. According to the taunka spirit Buniq, Galford managed to find the Spark of Tyr and his mind was then flooded by memories stored in the artifact of the noble watcher. When he lear
Galindre is a human located in the Opera Hall in the Return to Karazhan. She is a part of the Opera Hall: Wikket encounter along with Elfyra.
Gale Burst is a Windwalker monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Fists of the Wind and Light on Your Feet (windwalker) traits.

Gaius Duffy is a deceased human located in a cave behind the Witch of the Woods's house at Fernwood Ridge in Tiragarde Sound, along with the body of Lady Martisha and a Ritual Effigy. Interacting with the effigy will cause the two bodies to float into the air while a Twin-hearted Construct rises from where the effigy sat. Gaius and Martisha were presumably tricked by the Witch of the Woods into taking part in a ritual that bound them to the construct.
Galley Chef Sevensun is a blood elf located aboard The Black Arrow in Darkshore during the Battle for Darkshore.
Galakhad is a rare elite proto-dragon that spawns in the southwestern portion of the Frosted Spine in southwestern Forbidden Reach.
Gai Plin's Imperial Brew is a Brewmaster monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Tranquil Spirit.

Galley Chief Steelbelly is a member of The Maiden's Fancy, the boat that runs between the ports of Ratchet and Booty Bay. He's also the ship's cook, and will gladly give you something to eat and drink... for a price. Oddly enough, he's the only chief to be a higher level than his captain, as to why, it's unclear.

Garona Halforcen is a half-orc half-draenei, though most (including herself) believed she was half-human until the truth was revealed to her. She is an assassin and was an emissary of the Horde during the first invasion of Azeroth, and was the reluctant murderer of King Llane Wrynn. Later on, she joined her son and the other members of the New Council of Tirisfal in their battle against the Twilight's Hammer cult. Recently, Garona has been aiding the Horde, notably during the war against Deathwing and the Fourth War. She is also one of the leaders of the Uncrowned.

Garel Redrock is a dwarf located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. People who attended BlizzCon received a card with a code on it, and could give their code to Garel or his companion Ransin Donner to receive the Pink Murloc Egg.
Garneg Charskull is a rare mob orc found in the Wetlands between the Angerfang Encampment and Whelgar's Excavation Site.
Garon Hutchins is a human food vendor located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. He is the last surviving family member of a soldier named Vargus, and maybe aunt Heliana.
Gardok Ripjaw is an orc found in Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.

Garrick was a wizard apprentice, and old friend of Adric. Abandoning his master's research, he came looking for Adric once he heard about a dead man with a crossbow that matched a description he knew of as a child. Hoping to save his childhood friend from the Plague, he tried to convince Adric to follow him to his cart where his master could find a way to cure him. When Garrick started down the hill he was shot in the back and started his journey to the other side. Whether these two are still friends living within the unnamed blighted forest is unknown.

Gargal is an orc located at New Kargath in Badlands. He is now mercenary with a group known as the Bad Dogs. Before the Cataclysm, he was known as Grunt Gargal and was part of the Kargath Expeditionary Force. An arrow once landed on his head.

Garo'thal was a night elf soldier under the command of the noble Ravencrest. He was ordered to send messengers to every military post and commander to call for reinforcements against the Burning Legion. His status is unknown.
Garnett is a human warrior who underestimated his goblin opponent in a Gadgetzan gladiator tournament fight.
Garg is an orc found in Grizzly Hills. He was originally found in Hatchet Hills in Ghostlands.
Garley Lightrider is the blood elf located at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. Her journal is found close by. She also appears in Azsuna.
Garm Bonehew is an orc food and drink vendor located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
Garnia is a water spirit located at Ruby Lake on the Timeless Isle.
Gareth is a dwarf located in Southport in Spires of Arak. He has an Anodized Robo Cub named Sir Bearington.
Gar'lua is an orc located at the in . She raises wolves for the .
Garag Earthtongue is an orc follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Garenth is a night elf from New Thalanaar. After Rendow found Aramar Thorne and his group, Garenth arrived to report Rendow about an approaching Grimtotem attack.
Garadar Guard Captain is a Mag'har orc located in Garadar in Nagrand.
Garrett Elmendorf is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Garrick Blacksteel is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Nazmir and Uldir.
Garn Blackwolf is an orc located at Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar.
Gaping Maw was an Azerite trait available to Vengeance demon hunters.
Gath'Ilzogg is a named orc, and one of the Warlords of the Blackrock clan.
Garryeth is a night elf banker located in the Temple Gardens in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Gatekeeper Melindra is a human located at the Violet Stand in Crystalsong Forest.
Garrod Pubhammer is a dwarf found in the Gilnean town of Surwich in the Blasted Lands. He can be found sitting next to a keg inside one of the houses.
Gath'ras was the only female orc at the Frostwolf clan meeting in the canceled Warcraft Adventures.
Gary Henton is a human weapon vendor located at Honor's Stand in the Southern Barrens.
Gato is a pandaren monk trainer located at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
Gash'nul is a Mag'har orc Rok'nah captain and wind rider master located at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh during Theramore's Fall.
Garvan Bitterstone is a dwarf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Gaula Axefuty is an orc meat vendor located in Southwind Village in Silithus: The Wound.
Gary Cofferdam is a human located in the Drust Bar in Anyport in Drustvar.
Gary Peterson is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.

Gelbin Mekkatorque is the current king of the gnomes and High Tinker of Gnomeregan. He was previously the elected leader of gnomekind, though as one of the perks of his station, he liked to style himself as "King of Gnomes". Gelbin has been at the helm of the gnome race during some of its most difficult and trying times. Since his title was an elected one, the fact that he held his position throughout such hardship is a testament to the love his people have for him. A brilliant inventor, Gelbin rose quickly to prominence among the meritocratic gnomes with his innovative designs and creative problem-solving skills. He built the very first functioning mechanostrider, assisted in the developmen

Gazz'uz is an orc warlock hiding in the cave system of Skull Rock, a Burning Blade hideout, in Durotar. He is a member of the Burning Blade coven and his small rebellion on the outskirts of Orgrimmar poses threat to Neeru Fireblade as told by the mysterious voice inside his Eye of Burning Shadow. He used to be level 14 and have a Voidwalker Minion, but this was changed in a patch.

Gavin Gnarltree is a human weapon vendor located in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Gavin was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.

Gaval Moch is an old human castle in the Silverpine Forest. The old ruined castle is constructed of heavy masonry blocks. The castle is falling into ruin and decay as the forest reclaims its stones. It lies about ten miles northeast of Deadhollow. Gaval Moch squats in a depression in the spongy forest ground. The castle may once have been impressive but is now a ruined hulk. Turrets and battlements have fallen away, and masonry blocks lie scattered on the ground like children’s toys. The second story is missing its roof in most places, and its walls have crumbled. Gavin Ward is a human located in Fort Wildervar in Howling Fjord.
Gautter is a human located in Scalawag Point in the Howling Fjord.
Gelrynd is a dwarf located in Valiance Keep in the Borean Tundra. He is larger than the average dwarf.
Gavan Grayfeather is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman of the Earthen Ring found at the Heart of Azeroth. There he offers his services to shamans by resetting artifact traits.
Gavan Crunchore is a Dark Iron dwarf trade goods vendor located at Iron Summit in the Searing Gorge.
Gavran Goodspade is a dwarf general goods vendor located at Dustwind Dig in the Badlands.
Jesi is an orc child located at the Dreadmist Camp in the Northern Barrens. He has a pet kodo.
Gelgrig is an orc located at The Fel Forge in Tanaan Jungle.
Gemyl Moltensteel is a dwarf banker located at Bronzebeard's Vault in Stormshield.
Gazra is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.

Gelnar was an orc who lived on Draenor during the rise of the Gorian Empire and was responsible for the creation of the legendary weapon known as the Doomhammer. Faced with the problem of preventing the orcs from being enslaved by the ogres, he wandered alone in contemplation for many days. One day, a storm forced him to take shelter in a Gorgrond steam cavern, where Gelnar then began to experience fever-induced visions. Giving both his body and spirits to the elements, he submerged himself in a pool of lava and was miraculously unharmed. Gavvin Stoutarm was a dwarf sent by Brann Bronzebeard and Anduin Wrynn on an expedition to Silithus. He was in charge of the Explorer's League expedition, which encompassed a gnome named Sapphronetta Flivvers, three dwarves, and a handful of night elf Sentinel bodyguards, which included Sentinel Cordressa Briarbow. On the first night in Silithus, Gavvin commented that he would sleep well that night because he would be guarded by the elves. One of his dwarven companions retorted saying it would be the six pints of brew he drank that would help me sleep well. In the middle of the night, his camp was attacked by Horde forces but he wasn't vulnerable, despite having no weapon. He fought back the
Geldrin is a dwarf located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.

Genjuros was an orc blademaster of the Blackrock clan and commander of the Blackrock Warriors who defended the demon gate which the lich Kel'Thuzad used to commune with the demon lord Archimonde. Arthas and Kel'thuzad killed him along with four other orcs guarding the demon gate.

General Angerforge is a Dark Iron dwarf mini-boss located in the West Garrison within the instance Blackrock Depths. He is the venerable general of the Dark Iron armies. Before going into the gnomish workshop/golem factory, take a left down the stairs. Angerforge holds Marshal Windsor's Lost Information, one of two quest items needed for Marshal Windsor in the Alliance Onyxia chain quest. His forces are also wanted annihilated by the Horde's Warlord Goretooth for the mass murder of the 109th division of the Kargath Expeditionary Force.

General Bjarngrim is an Iron vrykul warrior and the first boss in the Halls of Lightning. He commands the Iron vrykul of the Unyielding Garrison at the entrance to the Halls. He can be skipped if you take a different route.
George Goodman is a human found in his shop, Goodman's General Goods, in the Festival Lane in Old Stratholme.
General Lightsbane is a death knight found in the Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

General Grimaxe is the leader of the Dark Iron dwarves attacking the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh. He can be seen riding a unique Dark Iron Golem while attempting to rally his troops at the frozen lake south of the airfield. Though he worked under orders from Ambassador Slaghammer, a known Twilight's Hammer loyalist, it is unknown if Grimaxe himself and his forces were Hammer cultists as well. He drops no loot and awards no experience.

General Marstone is a Wildhammer dwarf shaman and the field commander of 7th Legion troops at the 7th Legion Base Camp in Silverpine Forest. After his death at the hands of the Horde, he was succeeded by Horran Redmane.
Gerald Fairbanks is a human general goods vendor with the Argent Crusade, stationed inside the Crown Guard Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.

Genevieve is a human located just outside Northshear Abbey, which she owns. In front of her is her daughter, Anastasia. Through one of her dialogue options, it is revealed that she acts as the 'Royal barber', cutting the hair of the king of Stormwind, Anduin Wrynn.

General Warhowl is an orc envoy from Garrosh Hellscream, overseeing the Forsaken's invasion of Gilneas. He is seen meeting with Lady Sylvanas and High Executor Crenshaw during The Hunt For Sylvanas. He reminds the Dark Lady that use of the Forsaken Blight is strictly forbidden, though the Forsaken do not seem too eager to heed his opinion. His fate after the invasion is unknown.
Geoshaper Maren is a rare human located at the northside of The Loch in Loch Modan.
George Randolph is a human general goods vendor located at the Menders' Stead in the Western Plaguelands.

Gervase was a worgen who acted as the leader of the Wolf Cult in Duskwood. At some point, Gervase retook the Scythe of Elune and has been using it in rituals to transform people into worgen. He was approached by a human called Mardigan who infiltrated his Wolf Cult. Though Gervase considered him a fine candidate for their ranks, Mardigan refused to undergo the final test of a kill to become a worgen. Gervase wanted to turn the young man into a worgen anyways and abducted him, sending him to Roland's Doom. Mardigan's father, Karlain, alongside Revil Kost and Ambrose, wanted to free Mardigan. As the trio entered the mine, Gervase infected Mardigan turning him into a worgen. After seeing this,
General Vul'gath is an orc found at Agurak's Fall in Frostfire Ridge. Gutgore is his pet. Scout Ruk'Gan wants his death to avenge his daughter.
General Ushet Wolfbarger is an orc located in Warspear Outpost in Ashran.

General Kull'krosh is the commander of Ironfist Harbor in . He can be found at the top of the harbor's main keep, where he is apparently overseeing the recruitment of the Warsong into the ranks of the Iron Horde by constantly shouting out motivational speeches.
General Aevd is a tauren Horde general in Ashran, found in the Warspear Keep in Warspear Outpost. He also serves as Conquest gear vendor.

Genevere Hymnsorrow is the Horde priest leader of Ashran, found in Warspear Outpost. She can be found patrolling the secondary entrance to the base, walking up and down the curving slope with two Warspear Centurions.

Ger'hel is a blue-haired orc from the and the mate of the Iron Wolf with whom she had met and began hunting 20 years before the formation of the Iron Horde. Soon after its formation, she stood by him when preparing to ambush Garad and Ga'nar. Her current status is unknown.
Geralt Flamestrider is a blood elf food and drink vendor located at in Talador.
Georgitte Tyron is a human auctioneer found at the Auction House in Stormshield.

General Lena Stormpike was a dwarf paladin. A statue in her honor can be found in Sanctum of Light. Its plaque says: A stalwart combatant and defender of justice, fallen defending her home from the foul demons of the Burning Legion. Azeroth is darker for her passing.
Geth'xun is a fel lord appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore, summoned by . He later appeared at the Storm's Eye Overlook of the Maelstrom and Deepholm.
General Xakal is a fel lord located in the Fel Breach in the Arcway.

General Bret Hughes is a human officer located on the Sword of Dawn prior to the battle for the Broken Shore and prior to the battle for Lordaeron above the Seething Shore. He trained the novice adventurers transported by the gunship.

Gerald Crowe is a human that used to live in Stratholme with his wife, Lavinia, prior to the Third War. When the Scourge came the two of them were separated and Lavinia killed. Gerald later moved to Goldshire and married again. He learned that Lavinia was raised as an undead and she still considered him a husband. An undead named Garth Beeks wanted to contact Gerald in order to be introduced to Lavinia.
General Zeonar is an annihilan general of the Burning Legion located in Val'sharah during the Legion's assault on Val'sharah.
General Darlok was an orc located in Iron Siegeworks and taken out by the followers sent from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.

George is a human paladin featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Along with Karl he first appeared during the Journey of Un'Goro and got lost. They eventually ended up underground.
George Mitchell is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Georgie Woodburn is a human located at Braddock & Son's Ladder Co. in Mariner's Row in Boralus.
Geraldine is a human located in Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.

Private Geoffrey Van Houten was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Songswallow, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Genny is a dwarf located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.

General Cadarin is a human that arrived to the Horde-allied Plunder Harbor in Tiragarde Sound to demand the body of Derek Proudmoore. He caught Marshal M. Valentine and demanded an exchange of Derek for Valentine which Nathanos Blightcaller refused. Cadarin thus executed Valentine and Nathanos sent the Horde adventurer to kill the general. Lilian Voss also assisted in the attack against Cadarin, killing him.

General Kaal is a Stoneborn and commander of the Stone Legion forces under Sire Denathrius. Unlike other stoneborn, she is recognizable by her eyepatch and scarlet-gold armor. She serves alongside General Grashaal and Myskia. She is the final boss of the Sanguine Depths, where she escapes at 70%, and a dual-boss with Grashaal in Castle Nathria as the Stone Legion Generals.
Gertrud is an orc vendor located at Rusza'thar Reach in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Ghrawt is an orc bow vendor located in Razor Hill in Durotar. During the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar, he was found at the Razor Hill Outskirts. He appears at Razor Hill during the Kosh'harg.
Ghok'kah is an orc tailoring vendor located in Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh.
Gharash is an orc blacksmithing vendor located in Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows.

Giago was a member of the Gordunni Gladiator Team of Ancient Draenor: the previous year's team champions of the Crimson Ring tournament. He was killed by his teammate Brlee during a battle against Varian "Lo'Gosh" Wrynn, Valeera Sanguinar and Broll Bearmantle in Dire Maul.
Ghoul Frenzy is a death knight talent in the Unholy Tree. You will have to spend 31 points in Unholy to learn this spell.

Gharga is the captain of the Blood and Thunder. He was formerly its first mate, when the former captain, Briln, had used the ship to ferry magnataur from Northrend to battle the Alliance in Ashenvale. When Garrosh Hellscream promoted Briln for his service, Gharga became the ship's new captain. His first mate is Lokhor. He was initially disappointed when the Blood and Thunder did not participate in the Razing of Northwatch until he was informed that he was to lead the naval fleet against Theramore. Giant-Slayer Kul is an orc located in the Coldsnap Bluffs in Frostfire Ridge, between Colossal's Fall and the level 100 ogre area at the northern end of the Cracking Plains.
Gilda Cloudcaller is a Wildhammer dwarf located at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the Hinterlands.
Gija is an orc mage trainer located in the Arcane Enclave in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade.
Giantslayer Zhakta is an orc who attacks Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Gifted Student is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Full Keg and Obstinate Determination traits.
Gigi I Wynn is a blood elf located in Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
Gilshalan Windwalker is a night elf found sitting alone on the steps at the base of Aldrassil in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Gina MacGregor is a human trade goods vendor located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. She was present during the Legion Invasions.
